key_idea: Each occupied room has 2 lamps on.
steps: 20 lamps are on, and each occupied room has 2 of them.
20 lamps are 10 pairs, so 10 rooms are occupied.
The hotel has 15 rooms: 15 - 10 = 5 rooms are empty.

choice_feedback.A: If only 3 rooms were empty, 12 rooms would have 24 lamps on.
choice_feedback.B: If only 4 rooms were empty, 11 rooms would have 22 lamps on.
choice_feedback.D: If 6 rooms were empty, 9 rooms would have only 18 lamps on.
choice_feedback.E: 10 is the number of occupied rooms, not empty ones.
